node.title: L1 tangent Hasse root-pinning census
node.statement: For an exact shell member U-P=LQ on a squarefree split domain, the canonical tangent owner is T=gcd(L,Q). Fixing a degree-r domain divisor D|L gives D|Q iff D^2|U-P, equivalently P and its first Hasse derivative match U at every D-root. This confluent evaluation map on degree-below-k codewords has rank min(k,2r), so each fixed exact owner supports at most q^max(k-2r,0) members and the degree-r tangent stratum has size at most binom(n,r)q^max(k-2r,0), without support-subset overcount. Multiplication by Q modulo L has rank a-r, so the w=a-k Pade Jacobian has corank at most min(w,r). The raw binomial sum is not asserted to be row-sharp.
